result.instructions: Tools for Healthie, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Healthie data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run healthie_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run healthie_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run healthie_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. healthie_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: healthie_current_user
tools.title: Current user / account
tools.description: Fetch the authenticated Healthie account (the provider/user that owns the API key). Good first call to verify auth. Read-only. GraphQL: query currentUser.

tools.name: healthie_get_organization
tools.title: Get organization
tools.description: Fetch the current organization / practice (name, NPI, contact, user counts). Read-only. GraphQL: query organization.

tools.name: healthie_list_patients
tools.title: List patients / clients
tools.description: List patients/clients, optionally filtered by keyword search or active status. Read-only. GraphQL: query users(keywords, offset, page_size, should_paginate, active_status).

tools.name: healthie_get_user
tools.title: Get a user / patient
tools.description: Fetch a single user (patient or provider) by id. Read-only. GraphQL: query user(id).

tools.name: healthie_list_appointments
tools.title: List appointments
tools.description: List appointments, optionally filtered by patient, provider, date range, time-filter or status. Read-only. GraphQL: query appointments(user_id, provider_id, filter, startDate, endDate, filter_by_appointment_status).

user_id.description: Filter to appointments for this patient/client id.

provider_id.description: Filter to appointments for this provider id.

tools.name: healthie_get_appointment
tools.title: Get an appointment
tools.description: Fetch a single appointment by id. Read-only. GraphQL: query appointment(id).

tools.name: healthie_list_appointment_types
tools.title: List appointment types
tools.description: List the practice's appointment types (services), optionally keyword-filtered. Read-only. GraphQL: query appointmentTypes(keywords, offset, page_size, should_paginate).

keywords.description: Free-text search over appointment type names.

tools.name: healthie_list_forms
tools.title: List charting / intake form templates
tools.description: List custom module form templates (charting notes, intake forms), optionally by keyword or category. Read-only. GraphQL: query customModuleForms(keywords, category, offset, page_size, should_paginate).

tools.name: healthie_list_form_answer_groups
tools.title: List completed forms / charting notes
tools.description: List completed form submissions (charting notes / filled intake forms), optionally scoped to a patient or a form template. Read-only. GraphQL: query formAnswerGroups(user_id, custom_module_form_id, should_paginate, offset).

user_id.description: Filter to submissions for this patient id.

custom_module_form_id.description: Filter to submissions of this form template id.

tools.name: healthie_list_documents
tools.title: List documents
tools.description: List documents, optionally scoped to a patient (viewable_user_id) or by keyword. Read-only. GraphQL: query documents(viewable_user_id, keywords, offset, page_size, should_paginate).

viewable_user_id.description: Patient id whose documents to list.

tools.name: healthie_list_tasks
tools.title: List tasks
tools.description: List tasks, optionally scoped to a client or filtered by completion status. Read-only. GraphQL: query tasks(client_id, completed_status, offset, per_page).

client_id.description: Filter to tasks about this client id.

tools.name: healthie_list_goals
tools.title: List goals
tools.description: List goals, optionally scoped to a patient. Read-only. GraphQL: query goals(user_id, offset, per_page).

user_id.description: Filter to goals for this patient id.

tools.name: healthie_list_metric_entries
tools.title: List metric entries
tools.description: List tracked metric entries (weight, blood pressure, etc.), optionally scoped to a client or a category. Read-only. GraphQL: query entries(client_id, category, offset, page_size).

client_id.description: Filter to entries for this client id.

tools.name: healthie_list_conversations
tools.title: List conversations
tools.description: List messaging conversations, optionally between the current user and a given user. Read-only. GraphQL: query conversations(user_id).

user_id.description: Get conversations between the current user and this user id.

tools.name: healthie_create_task
tools.title: Create a task (WRITE — creates a record)
tools.description: Creates a task in Healthie (additive). Requires content (the task text); optionally attach it to a client (user_id), set a due_date, priority, or created_by_id. GraphQL: mutation createTask(input: createTaskInput).

user_id.description: The client/user the task is about.

created_by_id.description: Id of the user creating the task.

tools.name: healthie_create_note
tools.title: Create a note / chat entry (WRITE — creates a record)
tools.description: Creates a note/chat entry in Healthie (additive). Requires content (the note text); optionally attach it to a client (user_id) or mark it as an org chat. GraphQL: mutation createNote(input: createNoteInput).

user_id.description: The client/user the note is about.

org_chat.description: True if created in the organization chat context.
